visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair, a headband, and a brown 'SEA MARKET' t-shirt speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit restaurant. She wears a gold chain necklace and multiple bracelets, gesturing frequently to emphasize her points while looking directly at the lens. (2) The scene cuts to a high-angle shot on an escalator where the main character is accompanied by another woman, a man, and a toddler; they are all smiling and looking at the camera. (3) The woman holds a smartphone in front of her face, displaying an app interface for 'WaySim' and demonstrating how to set up an eSIM. Graphics of a globe and airplane appear as overlays. (4) Inside an airplane cabin, the woman is seen interacting playfully with a toddler and another woman in the seats behind her. (5) In a hotel lobby with warm, low lighting and ornate red carpeting, the woman shows her phone screen running a speed test with the 'Speedtest' app. (6) Standing outdoors in a park-like setting with green trees, she demonstrates the speed of downloading a video on her mobile device. (7) At an outdoor amusement park (Disneyland) during the day, the woman wears bear-ear headbands and holds her phone to show a final connectivity test result while crowds walk in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice provides fast-paced narration over a bright, upbeat electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. A 'ding' SFX triggers with the appearance of the first title card. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX marks the visual cut to the escalator scene; the BGM maintains a consistent rhythmic drive. (3) Digital interface 'clicks' and 'bubble' SFX are heard as the narrator explains phone operations; vocal pitch rises to show enthusiasm. (4) Background sounds of a child's laughter are layered under the main narration. (5) A rhythmic 'stinger' SFX emphasizes the speed test numbers appearing on screen. (6) A final brand jingle with a synthesized 'ping' sound concludes the audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution/Tutorial -> Validation -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote WaySim eSIM services by demonstrating their ease of use and high-speed performance during a family trip to Hong Kong. The video uses a tutorial format combined with real-world travel 'proof' to build trust and encourage viewers to use a discount code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides a direct tutorial on how to use the brand's app and shares a specific discount code 'Done' for viewers.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines personal vlog elements with a product endorsement, using high-density text and fast editing to maintain engagement. The cross-modality synchronization between speed test results and energetic BGM reinforces the brand message of high speed.
